name: research-center-gate
description: Closes the research-center-gate playtest's #442 parity gap (docs/plans/scenario-assertions-and-playtest-removal.md): clicking Queue Research on an already-placed building must be rejected on screen — not silently accepted — while zero Research Centers exist anywhere on site, and the identical click must succeed once one is placed. building-research-visual.json/building-research-progression-visual.json only ever exercise this after a Research Center already exists, so neither covers the no_research_center precondition (getQueueBlockCode, BuildingResearch.ts) at all.

steps.description: Setup: load the Tutorial Pit terrain — tutorial_start is never called, so no rail restricts tile picks below.
Place a living quarters, tier 1, with no Research Center on site — the building this scenario will try (and fail, then succeed) to queue research on.

Click Queue Research on the placed living quarters' own row — no Research Center exists yet, so getQueueBlockCode must return no_research_center and the click must be rejected on screen, not silently swallowed.

expect.note: Cash unchanged and no research queued proves the click was rejected (#442's prerequisite gate), not silently swallowed.

steps.description: Place a Research Center, tier 1 — the prerequisite the previous step was missing.
Click the identical Queue Research control on the living quarters again — now that a Research Center is placed, the tier-2 cost-only task must actually queue.

expect.note: Cash dropped by exactly the tier-2 cost-only research price ($5,000, 0 ticks, no conditions per RESEARCH_TASK_DEFS) — the task actually queued this time, purely from clicking.

steps.description: Let the cost-only research task resolve — 0-tick research resolves on the first tick processed after queueing.

Proof the unlock is real, not just queued: tier 2 living quarters actually builds now, in both modes. Goes one step further than the playtest's own beat 7 (which stops at asserting the Place button is usable) so command mode has a real completion to check against — equals/increased have no interaction-only exemption (unlike usable/blocked/tutorialStep, scenario-types.ts's ScenarioStepGoal), so a step whose interaction only set the tier selector without clicking Buy would assert a buildingCount increase interaction mode never produced.

expect.note: Tier-2 living_quarters construction cost is $25,000 (BuildingDefs.ts), on top of two ticks' worth of operatingCostPerTick from the living_quarters+research_center already placed — cash uses decreased not an exact equals since this follows a tick step (same class as building-research-visual.json's Finding #12). isTierUnlocked is genuinely true, not merely queued, or this build would still be rejected the same way the pre-Research-Center attempt was.
